name: python-time-series-window
title: Windowed aggregates that admit what arrived late
blurb: Half-open windows aligned to the epoch, a watermark derived from the data, and a buffer that keeps an aggregate open until the watermark closes it. Events that arrive after that are reported as too_late and never rewrite an emitted number; empty windows are listed as missing instead of counted as zero, and the mean of nulls stays undefined.
default_description: Window a time series with a data-derived watermark, and report what arrived too late to count.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
